replies.body: lmolkova asked for this note in #713, and the Vertex AI provider page is tracked in #717. The field does survive SDK conversion: google-genai 2.30.0 parses `usageMetadata.trafficType` into `usage_metadata.traffic_type` (a `TrafficType` enum, e.g. `ON_DEMAND`), and google-cloud-aiplatform 2.4.0 has `traffic_type` on the v1 `UsageMetadata`. The pinned mock server doesn't return `trafficType`, so a scenario reading it would emit nothing today. I can drop the sentence and move it to #717 if you'd rather keep the registry to what the scenarios show.
